title_en: Information for Applicants Admitted in the 2027 Graduate School First-Round Admission
summary: Applicants admitted to the graduate school in the 2027 first-round (전기) admission must register by paying tuition between 1 February 2027 (Mon) 10:00 and 5 February 2027 (Fri) 16:00, using the tuition bill printed from the admission website. They must also submit original degree (graduation) certificates and any other required documents by 11 February 2027 (Thu) to the academic administration office of the college or graduate school to which their admission unit belongs (Natural Sciences and Engineering: the department office). Admission will be cancelled if documents are not submitted on time without a special reason.
applies_to: All applicants admitted to the graduate school in the 2027 first-round (전기모집) admission; registration and document submission are mandatory. Bachelor's degree certificate: master's and integrated master's-doctoral program admittees. Master's degree certificate: doctoral program admittees. Immigration record or medical certificate: only those admitted after taking a video interview. Additional verification documents: only graduates of foreign universities or graduate schools.

dates.what: Registration (tuition payment) period for all admitted applicants; the tuition bill can be printed during this period
Period in which the certificate of admission can be printed (it cannot be reissued afterwards)
dates.when: Only during the announcement period and the registration period

conditions: Tuition can be paid only at NongHyup Bank (nationwide), Woori Bank or Shinhan Bank, by virtual account transfer or credit card.
The certificate of admission can be printed only during the announcement and registration periods and will not be reissued.
The immigration record certificate, medical certificate or similar document is required only from those admitted after a video interview, as requested by the admission unit.
Graduates of foreign universities must submit an apostille with their degree (graduation) certificate.
If the country is not a member of the Apostille Convention, submit a Confirmation of Overseas Educational Institution or consular confirmation instead.

Graduates of universities in China must submit consular confirmation or an apostille of both the graduation certificate and degree certificate, together with the CHSI Online Verification Report of Student Record.
Documents not written in Korean or English must be accompanied by a notarised Korean or English translation.
If documents are not submitted by the deadline without a special reason, admission will be cancelled.
steps: During the registration period, print the tuition bill from the admitted-applicant confirmation screen on the admission website (admission.snu.ac.kr) > Graduate School (대학원) > General Graduate School (일반대학원) > Notices (공지사항) board, and check the amount due.
Pay the tuition between 1 February 2027 10:00 and 5 February 2027 16:00 by virtual account transfer or credit card (banks: NongHyup, Woori, Shinhan).
During the announcement or registration period, print your certificate of admission from the same admitted-applicant confirmation screen; it cannot be reissued.

Prepare the original bachelor's degree certificate (master's or integrated master's-doctoral admittees) or master's degree certificate (doctoral admittees), with an apostille, consular confirmation, Confirmation of Overseas Educational Institution, CHSI report and notarised translation as applicable.
If you were admitted after a video interview, prepare one immigration record certificate, medical certificate or other document requested by your admission unit.

Submit the documents by 11 February 2027 to the academic administration office (교무행정실) of the college or graduate school your admission unit belongs to; College of Natural Sciences and College of Engineering admittees submit to their department or school office instead.
translation:
[Graduate School] Information for Applicants Admitted in the 2027 Graduate School First-Round Admission

1. Registration of admitted applicants (tuition payment)
 a. Registration period: 1 February 2027 (Mon) 10:00 to 5 February 2027 (Fri) 16:00
 b. Banks for payment: NongHyup Bank (nationwide), Woori Bank, Shinhan Bank
 c. Payment method: virtual account transfer, credit card
 d. Amount: can be checked on the tuition bill
 e. Tuition bill: can be printed during the registration period from the admitted-applicant confirmation screen ⇒ Admission website (admission.snu.ac.kr) - Graduate School (대학원) - General Graduate School (일반대학원) - Notices (공지사항) board

2. Certificate of admission
Can be printed from the admitted-applicant confirmation screen ⇒ Admission website (admission.snu.ac.kr) - Graduate School (대학원) - General Graduate School (일반대학원) - Notices (공지사항) board. ※ The certificate of admission can be printed only during the announcement and registration periods and will not be reissued.

Document submission: by 11 February 2027 (Thu) / to the academic administration office (교무행정실) of the college or graduate school to which the admission unit belongs. ※ Admittees of the College of Natural Sciences and the College of Engineering should submit to the office of the admission unit (department or school) they applied to.

Required documents | Remarks
- One bachelor's degree (graduation) certificate (master's and integrated master's-doctoral program admittees); one master's degree (graduation) certificate (doctoral program admittees) | Submit original documents. Graduates of foreign universities (graduate schools): see below.
- One immigration record certificate (출입국사실증명서), medical certificate or similar | Only for those admitted after taking a video interview. Documents requested by the admission unit in connection with the video interview.

※ Degree (graduation) certificates of graduates of foreign universities (graduate schools): submit together with an apostille.
- Countries not party to the Apostille Convention: submit together with a Confirmation of Overseas Educational Institution (국외교육기관확인서) or consular confirmation.
- Universities (graduate schools) located in China: graduates must submit consular confirmation or an apostille of the graduation certificate and degree certificate together with the Online Verification Report of Student Record from the China Ministry of Education's degree certification centre (CHSI) (see www.chsi.com.cn).
- Documents not written in Korean or English must be accompanied by a notarised Korean or English translation.

※ If documents are not submitted by the deadline without a special reason, admission will be cancelled.
